description: Add vertical shading fins to all east- and west-facing windows of the 4StoreyBuilding to reduce solar heat gain. Open the '4StoreyBuilding' project. Locate all zones on the East facade (containing 'E' in zone name, e.g., G.E02) and West facade (containing 'W' in zone name, e.g., G.W04) across all 4 floors. For every WINDOW object on the exterior walls of these zones, add both Left and Right vertical fins with a projection (height) of 2.5 feet. Specifically, set 'LEFT-FIN-H' and 'RIGHT-FIN-H' to 2.5. Do NOT add fins to North or South facing windows. Finally, run the simulation (Actions > Simulate Building Performance) and save the project.
